en.title: Avelo cuts 9 Wilmington routes and United drops 5 Canada routes in 2026 network trims
en.summary: Avelo Airlines has cut nine routes from Wilmington, North Carolina, this year, leaving 11 weekly departures there in November against 27 a year earlier, while United Airlines has terminated five US-Canada nonstop routes in 2026.
body: Avelo Airlines has drastically reduced its network from Wilmington International Airport (ILM) in North Carolina, readjusting down to just a handful of nonstop destinations. The carrier dropped eight routes in January, with one more terminated this August, for a total of nine cuts from Wilmington this year. Data from Cirium shows Wilmington will see 11 weekly departures in November, down from 27 at the same time last year. The eight January cuts were Wilmington to Fort Lauderdale, Long Island, Orlando, Fort Myers, Palm Beach, Punta Cana, Detroit and Manchester, all judged no longer financially viable, with aircraft to be better utilized elsewhere. The ninth cut, Wilmington to Rochester, followed in August. The Punta Cana link, the airline's first international service, lasted just two months before termination. Avelo is left at Wilmington with year-round services to Nashville, New Haven and Tampa.

United Airlines has also cut five routes to Canada this year, terminating five nonstop services between US hubs and Canada. Washington Dulles (IAD) lost two routes in September, to Calgary and Halifax, with Calgary operated by a mix of Boeing 737-800 and 737 MAX 8 aircraft and Halifax served until September on a Republic Airways E175. Chicago O'Hare (ORD) to Edmonton was terminated in September on the 737-800, leaving that city pair unserved nonstop, while Los Angeles to Toronto was cut in September on the MAX 9, leaving Air Canada and Porter Airlines as the operators there. Vancouver to Newark was chopped in October, on a mix of 737-900 and MAX 9 aircraft, and is now operated by Air Canada, with JetBlue serving Vancouver from JFK. Despite the five cancellations, Cirium data cited in the report identifies United as still the second-largest airline between the US and Canada, behind Air Canada and ahead of Delta Air Lines, WestJet and Porter Airlines, with its most popular Canada service, Newark to Toronto, maintaining 47 weekly departures in November, followed by Chicago O'Hare to Toronto with 41.

facts.claim: Avelo Airlines dropped eight routes from Wilmington in January 2026 and one more, to Rochester, in August, for nine cuts from Wilmington this year.
Wilmington will see 11 weekly Avelo departures in November 2026, down from 27 at the same time last year, according to Cirium data cited in the report.
Avelo's January Wilmington cuts were to Fort Lauderdale, Long Island, Orlando, Fort Myers, Palm Beach, Punta Cana, Detroit and Manchester.
Avelo's Punta Cana service was its first international service and lasted just two months.
United Airlines terminated five nonstop US-Canada routes in 2026: Washington Dulles to Calgary and Halifax, Chicago O'Hare to Edmonton, Los Angeles to Toronto, and Vancouver to Newark.
United's Dulles-Calgary and Dulles-Halifax routes ended in September 2026, as did Chicago-Edmonton and Los Angeles-Toronto, while Vancouver-Newark ended in October 2026.

United remains the second-largest airline between the US and Canada, behind Air Canada and ahead of Delta, WestJet and Porter, with Newark-Toronto at 47 weekly departures in November and Chicago-Toronto at 41.

zh.title: Avelo大砍威明頓9條航線、聯合航空取消5條加拿大航線
zh.summary: Avelo航空今年自北卡羅來納州威明頓取消9條航線，11月當地每週出發班次降至11班，低於去年同期的27班；聯合航空今年也終止5條美國—加拿大直飛航線。
body: Avelo航空大幅縮減北卡羅來納州威明頓國際機場（ILM）的航網，只剩下少數直飛目的地。該公司今年1月取消8條威明頓航線，8月再終止1條，合計9條；航空數據公司Cirium的資料顯示，威明頓11月每週出發班次為11班，低於去年同期的27班。1月取消的航線包括威明頓往勞德岱堡、長島、奧蘭多、邁爾斯堡、棕櫚灘、蓬塔卡納、底特律與曼徹斯特，原因是這些航線已不再具財務可行性，飛機改派至其他用途更有效益；8月取消的第9條航線為威明頓往羅徹斯特。蓬塔卡納航線是Avelo首條國際航線，僅營運2個月就終止。縮減後，Avelo在威明頓保留全年航線往納許維爾、紐黑文與坦帕。

聯合航空今年也取消5條往加拿大的航線，終止5條美國樞紐與加拿大之間的直飛服務。華盛頓杜勒斯機場（IAD）9月失去往卡加利與哈利法克斯的航線，其中卡加利航線以波音737-800與737 MAX 8混合執飛，哈利法克斯航線由共和航空E175執飛至9月為止；芝加哥歐海爾（ORD）往艾德蒙頓航線9月以737-800終止，兩城之間不再有直飛服務，洛杉磯往多倫多航線9月以MAX 9終止，改由加拿大航空與波特航空營運；溫哥華往紐華克航線10月以737-900與MAX 9混合機隊終止，現由加拿大航空營運，捷藍航空則自甘迺迪機場（JFK）服務溫哥華航線。儘管取消5條航線，Cirium資料仍顯示聯合航空是美國—加拿大之間第二大航空公司，僅次於加拿大航空、領先達美航空、西捷航空與波特航空；11月最繁忙的加拿大航線為紐華克—多倫多每週47班，其次為芝加哥歐海爾—多倫多每週41班。
